module: Flowgraph node 'Prepare Vehicle' (once_instant category). Prepares one or more vehicles for gameplay (electric and values) via self.mgr.modules.mission:prepareVehicle. Optional pins: vehId (default player vehicle) and vehicleIds (table of additional ids).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

workOnce.desc: Prepares vehId (or the player vehicle) with the second argument false, then each id of vehicleIds with the second argument true unless it is the main vehicle or the player.
